overview_description.description:
Stack Overflow is a platform for developers and programmers to share knowledge and solve coding challenges. It helps programmers get answers to their toughest coding questions, share knowledge with their coworkers in private, and find their next dream job.

Jeff Atwood and Joel Spolsky co-founded Stack Overflow in 2008 in New York, New York.
